english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the brown colour.
Use the shorter 啡色 as a common alternative for the coffee-brown color.

examples.english: I want to buy the brown shirt.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 fe1 sik1 go2 gin6 seot1 saam1

examples.english: This coffee color goes well with your room.
examples.jyutping: ni1 zek3 fe1 sik1 gei2 can3 nei5 gaan1 fong2
